items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Tulane and Levin. With the two pieces? Sheet music. On Tulane.

ctx.x: Did you make it? You know, did you help them with the sheet music?
Tulane and Levin. With the two pieces? Sheet music. On Tulane. Oh, Tulane you mean? Yeah, so how long did you help them sell the music? On Tulane Avenue. Let me see. Tulane Avenue.
